einzeiler: A collection of listener-submitted true horror and creepy encounter stories.
kurzfassung: This episode features various listener-submitted accounts of unsettling encounters and near-misses. Stories include a potential abduction attempt during a run and a strange encounter on a nature trail. Listeners also share experiences involving strangers peering through windows and threatening situations.
stichpunkte: A creepy encounter on a nature trail
A stranger staring through a window
An encounter involving a new neighbor
Being chased while dressed as Harley Quinn
An attempted kidnapping in Jacksonville, Florida
